evidence_items.explanation: The official analysis identifies a specific federal disclosure gap while also describing existing attribution requirements. It concerns the preceding day's legal position and does not establish the effectiveness of all applicable protections.

The FEC describes a request to clarify an existing prohibition, which cautions against treating AI-generated deception as entirely unregulated. Opening comments does not establish either comprehensive protection or its absence.
